statements.text: We should be clear about the distinction between data centers used for the normal operation of our phones and computers and data centers used to power AI that kills jobs, steals people’s work, and serves no societal value. We don’t need AI data centers and I am completely opposed to them being built in Michigan.

statements.text: What happens when AI models now—again, using this technology—are trained on historic or contemporary data that reflects past or present discrimination? Does not this risk create models that perpetuate or reinforce discriminatory practices? [...] Because it is teaching it to go around, telling on themselves.
statements.context: Congresswoman Tlaib speaks at a Financial Services Committee hearing on AI in financial services, focusing on discriminatory data practices in auto insurance.

statements.text: No one wants to live near a data center. People are beginning to learn more about how AI data centers can raise electricity costs in nearby neighborhoods by as much as 267%, consume millions of gallons of water per day, and can produce air, water, noise, and light pollution, especially when powered by dirty fossil fuels.
statements.venue: Press statement on Southfield AI data center vote

statements.text: I fully support the call for a national AI data center moratorium and look forward to working with @SenSanders and others to protect our communities from unaffordable utility bills and increased pollution. https://t.co/FOabJNPLqM
statements.quoted: Democrats reject Bernie Sanders’ data center pause https://t.co/jS1FjxWCOK

statements.text: A huge thank you to Inkster residents for packing last night's City Council meeting to share their opposition to an outrageous new AI data center proposal. I'm grateful to the Inkster City Council for asking the tough questions and declining to enter a MOU with the developer. https://t.co/p7HEGAaV3F

Flock – a private surveillance company worth $8.4 billion – contracts with ICE and CBP to turn out neighborhoods into mass surveillance zones. Their AI-powered license plate readers performed 20 billion scans of cars EVERY MONTH.

That should terrify everyone. https://t.co/vdG4SxsvLu

I am introducing a new bill, the No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act. Our bill would permanently ban large data centers on Federal lands, including military bases. It would also remove any existing qualifying AI data center and mandate site remediation to protect our health and our environment. [...] We should protect our public lands from data center destruction. [...] AI data centers bring noise, light, air, and water pollution. [...] We can tell this President that AI shouldn't be making military decisions and AI shouldn't trump our public health and our environmental laws.
statements.context: Verbatim floor speech in the House of Representatives introducing a bill to ban AI data centers on federal lands.

statements.text:
Our residents tell me loud & clear: AI data centers are not welcome. They pollute our environment & raise our bills–all to make the rich richer.

I introduced the No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act to stop this AI-addicted President from sacrificing our lands to Big Tech. https://t.co/L5dCl0YHAB

Everywhere I go in our district, our residents tell me loud and clear, data centers are not welcome in our communities. AI data centers bring noise, light, air, and water pollution, and can increase energy costs by as much as 267%. [...] Our corrupt, AI-addicted President cannot be allowed to sacrifice our federal lands so that Big Tech oligarchs can get richer. I will continue to push back against harmful AI data centers alongside our residents to protect our public lands, health, and environment.
statements.venue: Press release introducing No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act

statements.text:
Trump's rewarding his campaign donors with these toxic data center developments, and they're just getting started.

Our No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act would ban these dirty deals and affirm that our public lands are not for sale to Big Tech oligarchs. https://t.co/SlgcnOp2qv

We are in a climate crisis—and AI Data centers are making it worse. Even if one hasn't popped up in your community yet, polluted air and dirty water affects us all.

Congress must pass my No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act, now!

AI is advancing faster than its creators can responsibly control–and that’s directly from an AI researcher. It threatens our livelihoods, environment, education, and electoral system.

Congress needs to act NOW. https://t.co/0a5gpQcKee
statements.quoted: I resigned from Anthropic today. I spent the last three years doing pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic. Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives. More thoughts below.

statements.text: Mr. Speaker, the so-called Ratepayer Protection Act won't do a darn thing to protect us from AI data centers. It will only serve utility CEOs and encourage more data centers.

Congress has to face Big Tech bros threatening our way of life head-on. Mr. Speaker, Congress needs to pass a national moratorium on data centers and pass my No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act before Trump turns Yellowstone over to OpenAI and Oracle.
The strongest action Congress can take right now is to pass a national moratorium on data centers and enact a prohibition on federal lands,
